paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作部分中将目标论文归类为无线（Wireless-based）声学窃听方法之一，提及了RFID标签用于检测反射振动信号进行窃听，但未对目标论文的具体能力（如亚毫米级精度或穿墙能力）进行明确确认或详细描述，属于普通的文献回顾。

evidences.evidence_quote: Moreover, researchers also use RFID tags [15] and mmWave radar [16] to detect reflected vibration signals for eavesdropping.
evidences.evidence_context: Wireless-based approaches spy on voice information by analyzing wireless signals reflected from vibrating objects. For instance, Wei et al. [14] inspects subtle disturbances on a target loudspeaker and recovers the audio signal by analyzing the received signal strength (RSS) readings of WiFi packets. Moreover, researchers also use RFID tags [15] and mmWave radar [16] to detect reflected vibration signals for eavesdropping.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 该引用出现在相关工作部分，引用标记[15]对应目标论文，但仅在一句话中提及RFID标签用于窃听，未具体描述目标论文的亚毫米级精度或穿墙能力，属于普通的相关工作列举，无明确证据支持sub-mm或capability claim。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
